name: ComboboxPopup
description:
The glass list shared by Combobox, MultiSelect and TagInput: a polite live count, the
list state (refresh line, first-load skeleton rows, error with Retry, "type more"),
the empty row, options (grouped when they name a group) and the "N more" footer.
signature: <V extends string = string>({ items, query, search, loading, empty, check, }: ComboboxPopupProps<V>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: check
props.description: Reserve the ✓ column (single and multiple choice).

props.name: empty
props.description: Text for the empty row; receives the current query.

props.name: items
props.description: The collection rendered by the component. Stable identifiers preserve selection and keyboard focus.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show skeleton rows (static lists loading from elsewhere).

props.name: query
props.description: Current search text or typed query state.

props.name: search
props.description: The async search, when the list comes from a source.
